bugs.summary: Every spawn_agent session is retained, and a retained 'completed' session is exempt from the maxCompleted cap while cancelAll (only status 'running') and clear() (drops closeHandles without calling them) never release it, so each worker's agent, posix tools and LSP sidecars leak for the life of the parent.
bugs.evidence: src/subagent/agent-fleet.ts:418 `retained: true` on every spawn; run.ts:921 skips disposeSubAgentSession when `persist && turnSucceeded`, leaving teardown only to the registered close handle (run.ts:799-816). session-store.ts:384-387 excludes retained completed/running sessions from pruneCompleted; cancelAll at 712-719 (unchanged by the PR) filters `status === "running"`, which a done retained session never is; clear() 729-732 `closeHandles.clear()` without invoking. Fix PR #624 (base blob d83aff8b = head) drops the exemption (`s.lifecycleStatus !== "running"` only) and calls new releaseHandles() on eviction, adds a retained-session release loop to cancelAll, and invokes every close in clear().

bugs.summary: close_agent on a session still in agent setup (registerClose not yet called) finds no close handle, marks it shutdown and returns 'shutdown' without aborting the run; when onAgentReady later registers the handle nothing ever calls it, and every retry short-circuits on the shutdown status, so the agent is unreleasable and the success is false.
bugs.evidence: session-store.ts:671-681 only closes when `closeHandles.get(id)` exists, then 682-693 unconditionally sets lifecycleStatus 'shutdown' and returns 'shutdown' (cancelHandles is only deleted, not invoked); 670 returns early for shutdown on retry. registerClose (662-665) still stores a handle for the shutdown session. The handle is registered only in run.ts:799-816 after agent creation, while agent-fleet.ts:411-418 starts the session before. Fix PR #624 adds waitForCloseHandle and, when no handle arrives by the deadline, returns the honest in-progress lifecycleStatus instead of 'shutdown'.

bugs.summary: A deadline/cancel salvage returns a report through the success path after run.ts has already disposed the agent, but complete() leaves the session 'completed' with retained=true, so resume_agent accepts a session whose agent is gone.
bugs.evidence: run.ts:891-910 (outside the PR's hunks) returns `{report: forcedStopReport(...), stopReason}` for salvage-deadline/salvage-cancel without setting turnSucceeded, so the finally at run.ts:921 disposes the agent. agent-fleet.ts:488 calls `deps.sessions.complete(session.id, result.report)` for any resolved result; session-store.ts:614 sets lifecycleStatus 'completed' and leaves retained true; resumeOne (696-705) admits `completed && retained === true`. Fix PR #624 adds `agentRetained` to RunSubAgentResult (set only on the clean path), passes it from agent-fleet.ts:488, and complete() clears retained and the close handle when false.

bugs.summary: On the persist path the run's finally still calls runController.dispose(), which removes the parent-abort forwarding listener, so a later parent cancel never aborts runController.signal and closeOnAbort never tears down the retained session.
bugs.evidence: run.ts:916 `runController.dispose()` runs before the persist check at 921; dispose (run.ts:241-244, unchanged by the PR) does `parentSignal?.removeEventListener("abort", onParentAbort)`. closeOnAbort is registered on runController.signal (run.ts:785-790), not the parent signal. Fix PR #624 adds `dispose({ keepParentListener: persisting })` at this line and disposes fully inside boundedClose. Likely rather than certain: the impact depends on the parent signal aborting after the worker completes, which the PR's code does not show.

rejected.why: Re-anchored to run.ts:916 (the dispose call the fix changes) for b4; 921 is the persist gate, only renamed by the fix.

rejected.was: original labels session-store.ts 377-388, 610-613, 671-680 as one combined bug
rejected.why: Split into the three distinct defects the fix PR enumerates (b1 leak, b3 salvage, b2 setup-window close); sites tightened.

rejected.was: model findings (many prompts): Promise.race deadline timers in closeOne/boundedClose are never cleared
rejected.why: Not a behaviour defect: the pending timer just resolves a settled race after at most 30s; no state changes and no user-visible effect.

rejected.was: model findings: descendants close sequentially so close_agent is not bounded by one 30s deadline (N x deadline)
rejected.why: Intended: the tool description promises a ~30s deadline 'per session' (lifecycle-tools.ts:34-37), which is what the loop at 111-114 does.

rejected.was: model finding: descendantsClosingOrder uses a list() snapshot and ignores ordering/cycles
rejected.why: Speculation: parentSessionId is set once at start so no cycle can form, and deepest-first order per subtree is what the doc states.

rejected.was: model finding: resume_agent error message does not explain the failure
rejected.why: Style; the message includes the blocking lifecycle status.

rejected.was: model findings: boundedClose aborts an already-disposed controller / abort after runController.dispose() skips closeOnAbort
rejected.why: Wrong claim: run.ts dispose only removes the parent-signal listener (241-244); boundedClose aborts runController directly (run.ts:801) so closeOnAbort on runController.signal still fires, and closeOnAbort is also passed to disposeSubAgentSession.

rejected.was: model findings: closing a running session double-tears-down (boundedClose plus the run's finally)
rejected.why: Speculation: disposeSubAgentSession swallows every close/dispose error (dispose.ts:113-127); no shown harm. The salvage variant (close handle kept after teardown) is part of b3.

rejected.was: model findings: boundedClose/closeOne swallow teardown errors; a missed deadline is reported as shutdown without a log
rejected.why: Intended and documented: the close_agent description says a session missing the deadline 'is still marked shutdown; its teardown just keeps running in the background'.

rejected.was: model finding: turnSucceeded set before the return expression can still throw
rejected.why: Speculation: appendActivitySummary is a pure string helper; no throwing path shown.

rejected.was: model findings: start() replacing an existing id drops a live retained session's close handle
rejected.why: spawn_agent never passes an id (agent-fleet.ts:411-419), so start() uses createId(); id reuse only happens for task-tool callIds, which never register a close handle.

rejected.was: model finding: fail() marks shutdown without closing the agent
rejected.why: Wrong claim: a thrown run always disposes in run.ts's finally (persist only skips it when turnSucceeded), so shutdown is accurate.

rejected.was: model findings: resumeOne flips lifecycle to running with no turn in flight and leaves status 'done' (never completes again)
rejected.why: Intended per PR description and lifecycle-tools.ts header: resume_agent takes no prompt and only makes the session addressable; pushing input is the later interrupt_agent/followup_task lane. The cap-exemption consequence is b1.

rejected.was: model findings: concurrent closeOne calls return 'shutdown' before the first teardown finishes / race double-close
rejected.why: Consistent with the documented contract that 'shutdown' does not wait for teardown past the deadline; the handle is deleted before the await so close runs once.

rejected.was: model finding: resumeOne can succeed while a close is in progress
rejected.why: No harm: closeOne's mutate after the await sets shutdown regardless, and resume starts no work.
